_readme: TME_Templates_MarketPulseRates_v2.json — lives on GitHub as rates.json in Maranto25/tme-market-pulse (edit in the browser; no Netlify redeploy). Fill from Mortgage News Daily each business morning after ~9:30 AM CT. Leave a value null to render 'Data Pending' — never estimate. rate = percent (6.12), change = day-over-day in percentage points (+0.03 / -0.05 / 0). Ops: TME_Spec_MarketPulseDashboard_Ops_*
